claims.text: Pika's Aug 14 page introduces four models: Soundtrack (video-to-audio), SFX (text-to-effect), Speech (TTS), Music (full tracks).
Listed prices: SFX $0.0002/sec, Soundtrack $0.005/sec, Speech $0.01/min, Music $0.015/min via the API Club.
claims.context: Price card in captured body; cost-multiple claims vs rivals are vendor framing.

limitations.text: Cost-multiple claims (9x/20x/10x/2x vs named rivals) are Pika-reported on non-normalized units; not independently verified.
limitations.context: Evidence boundary retained for downstream editorial use.

limitations.text: Aug 18 per-model posts elaborate the Aug 14 family launch; they are not four additional launches.
